{"configMaps":{"config":{"data":{"squid.conf":"# Squid, one port per app instance: every request is logged with the instance that sent it, and
# refused unless a grant of that instance covers its host and port.
pid_filename none
pinger_enable off
cache deny all
via off
forwarded_for delete
shutdown_lifetime 3 seconds
logformat egress instance=%{instance}note granted=%{granted}note client=%>a method=%rm host=%>rd:%>rP status=%>Hs/%Ss bytes=%<st ms=%tr
http_port 3128 name=health
acl health myportname health
http_access deny health
# Requests only: the kubelet's probes connect every few seconds and send none.
acl request has request
access_log stdio:/dev/stdout logformat=egress request
cache_log stdio:/dev/stderr
acl port-443 port 443
http_port 30101 name=smoke-web-prod
acl smoke-web-prod myportname smoke-web-prod
note instance smoke-web-prod smoke-web-prod
acl smoke-web-prod-443 dstdomain -n swhurl-platform-backups-110927251694.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com
note granted yes smoke-web-prod smoke-web-prod-443 port-443
http_access allow smoke-web-prod smoke-web-prod-443 port-443
http_access deny all
"}}},"service":{"main":{"ports":{"p30101":{"port":30101}}}}}
